headline: Weathered Expanse Rages as Northern Passes Trade Blows
war_summary: Since the midday edition the wires have quickened again across the center and north. Callahan's Passage no longer stands wholly in Warden hands, showing nine held with one unheld after four changes in two hours and twenty on the day about Crumbling Post, with day losses near 9,400 on each side. The Weathered Expanse has reawakened after its morning lull with six changes in two hours and fifty-seven on the day, now two Warden, five Colonial and two unheld about Wightwalk, Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance, and day losses of about 9,058 Colonial and 13,263 Warden. Kuura Strand reports twelve changes in two hours and twenty-one on the day about Martti and Faden Point, while Fisherman's Row shows four in two hours and fifteen on the day about Black Well and Oceanwatch despite a Colonial roll of nine. The Nevish Line is stirring again with two changes in two hours and twelve on the day about Grief Mother at four Warden, three Colonial and one unheld. Palantine Berm and Stonecradle lie quiet since morning, the former still seven Warden after fifty-one changes, the latter with eleven on the day, while Stlican Shelf has paused in the last two hours after eighteen on the day last moving at 15:33.
